questions.def: Adverbs modify verbs. 'Beautifully' describes how she sings.
questions.question: She sings ___.

questions.def: Adjectives modify nouns. 'Careful' describes the driver.
questions.question: He is a ___ driver.

questions.def: The adjective 'happy' describes her feeling.
questions.question: She was ___ to see him.

questions.def: 'Harder' is the comparative form of 'hard' (adverb).
questions.question: He works ___ than his brother.

questions.def: 'Worst' is the superlative form of 'bad'.

questions.def: Use either 'taller' or 'more tall,' not 'more taller'.
